attribution.title: Vijfde Technische School, Meeuwenlaan 132, Amsterdam-Noord (1931-1935)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012101771 (CC0): yellow-brick wings with white classroom windows (multi-pane top lights), wide boxed eaves, dormers and roof lights, the stair tower with its tall barred windows, the gabled entrance risaliet with its arched portal and TECHNISCHE SCHOOL letters, the auto workshop's arched car door, and the 2001 wing's glazed ground storey, striped cladding and roof-playground fence, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the municipal monument register text. No pixels or meshes imported.
